_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.no_cards: Wax kaarar ah ma jiraan weli
player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Ciyaartoyga keliya vs Dealer

📖 MUUQAALKA CIYAARTA:
• Waxaad bilawdaa {start_chips} chip
• Dekkii kaararka ee keliya 52 kaarar (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Waxaad ciyaartaa dealer (guri)
• Marhalkasta waxay raacdaa qaabka Ultimate Texas Hold'em: waxaad gudbisaan ANTE iyo BLIND bets, hesho 2 kaarar oo qarsoon, go'aan ka gaadho PLAY bets ahaan ee marhalka, kaddibna muuji kartida bulshada iyo barbardhigo gacaylkaaga ugu fiican 5-kaarar ee dealer's.
• Ujeedadu waa inaad ugu badiso guushaada (marka aad leedahay gacayl fiican), halka aad yareysid khasaartada (marka aad leedahay gacayl xun).
• Ciyaarta waxay dhammaata marka aad gaadho 0 chip ama ka yar bilawga marhalka (HASI) ama dhamaystirto 1000 marhal oo chip leh (GUUSH)

💰 QAABKA BETTING:
• ANTE: Qiyamka mandatory ${ante} bet marhalkasta
• BLIND: Qiyamka mandatory ${ante} bet marhalkasta
• PLAY: Bet ahaan oo la doorto inta lagu jiro ciyaarta. Marhalkasta, waxaad dooran kartaa HAL KALE oo soo socota: (${ante4} haddii la sameeyo PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} haddii la sameeyo FLOP, ama ${ante} haddii la sameeyo RIVER. Waxaad sidoo kale fold kartaa river, oo aad iska dayacarto gacaylka, oo aad sameyno bet ahayn.)

🎴 KAARARKA QARSOON:
• Waxaad hesho 2 kaarar oo qarsoon (kaararkaaga qarsoon)
• Dealer waxay hesho 2 kaarar oo qarsoon (kaararka qarsoon ee dealer)
• 5 kaarar oo bulsho ah waxay la baxaan qarsoon bilawga
• Kaararka bulshada waxay muujiyanan marhalka kasta

🏆 DEALER QUALIFICATION:
• Dealer waxay u baahan tahay inay leedahay ugu yaraan PAIR (2 kaarar oo isku mid ah) si ay uga qalifyo, iyadoo adeegsanaysa 2 kaararka ee gacaylkeeda iyo 5 kaararka bulshada.
• Uga qalifynta dealer waxay saameynaysaa natiijada betting, sida ay noqon doonto la soo bandhigay.

🎮 MARHALKA CIYAARTA & FARIIMUHA:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Fariimaha: [4x] (${ante4}) ama [check]
  • [4x]: Gudbi ${ante4} PLAY bet, muuji 3 kaararka bulshada ee ugu horeeya
  • [check]: Bet ahayn oo dheeraad ah, muuji 3 kaararka bulshada ee ugu horeeya

📋 FLOP:
  • Haddii la sameeyo 4x bet: [skip] oo keliya ayaa la heli karaa (auto-muuji 2 kaararka bulshada ee ugu dambeeya)
  • Haddii la sameeyn 4x bet ahayn: [2x] (${ante2}) ama [check]
  • [2x]: Gudbi ${ante2} PLAY bet, muuji 2 kaararka bulshada ee ugu dambeeya
  • [check]: Bet ahayn oo dheeraad ah, muuji 2 kaararka bulshada ee ugu dambeeya

📋 RIVER:
  • Haddii la sameeyo 4x ama 2x bet: [skip] oo keliya ayaa la heli karaa (auto-dhaqaaqo showdown)
  • Haddii la sameeyn PLAY bet ahayn: [1x] (${ante}) ama [fold]
  • [1x]: Gudbi ${ante} PLAY bet, dhaqaaqo showdown
  • [fold]: Iska dayacarto gacaylka, waayay ANTE iyo BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Kaararka oo dhan waxay muujiyanan oo la qiimeyn doona
  • Gacaylka ugu fiican 5-kaarar ee 7 kaararka (2 qarsoon + 5 bulsho)
  • Bets waxay la saxiix doonaan qaabka bixin

💎 QAABKA BIXIN:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer ma u qalifyo: PUSH (bet la soo celiyay)
  • Dealer u qalifyo & aad guuleysatay: 1:1 bixin (bet + guush)
  • Dealer u qalifyo & aad waayay: Bet la waayay
  • Tie: PUSH (bet la soo celiyay)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Lama saameynayo uga qalifynta dealer
  • Aad guuleysatay: Bet la soo celiyay oo bixin dheeraad ah oo ku salaysan awooda gacaylkaaga
  • Aad waayay: Bet la waayay
  • Tie: PUSH (bet la soo celiyay)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Kaarar ka yar Straight: Bixin dheeraad ah oo la hayo

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Lama saameynayo uga qalifynta dealer
  • Barbardhig toosan: Gacaylkaaga ugu fiican vs Gacaylka dealer
  • Aad guuleysatay: 1:1 bixin (bet + guush)
  • Aad waayay: Bet la waayay
  • Tie: PUSH (bet la soo celiyay)

🎯 POKER HAND RANKINGS (Ugu fiican ilaa ugu xun):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 oo isku mid ah
  2. Straight Flush: 5 kaarar oo isku mid ah oo ku xiga
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 kaarar oo isku mid ah
  4. Full House: 3 kaarar oo isku mid ah + 2 kaarar oo isku mid ah
  5. Flush: 5 kaarar oo isku mid ah
  6. Straight: 5 kaarar oo ku xiga
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 kaarar oo isku mid ah
  8. Two Pair: 2 joyn oo kaarar oo isku mid ah
  9. One Pair: 2 kaarar oo isku mid ah
  10. High Card: Kaararka ugu sareeya oo guuleysta

⌨️  FARIIMUHA AHAAN:
• [4x] ama [play bet 4x]: Gudbi ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] ama [play bet 2x]: Gudbi ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] ama [play bet 1x]: Gudbi ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] ama [c]: Check (bet ahayn oo dheeraad ah)
• [fold] ama [f]: Fold (iska dayacarto gacaylka)
• [skip] ama [s]: Skip ilaa marhalka xigay (haddii la hayo fariin ahayn)

💡 TALLOOYINKA ISTIRAATIJI:
• Gacaylka bilawga ee awood badan (joyn, kaararka sare) waxay si joyn ugu fiicnaan karaan 4x bets
• Uga qalifynta dealer waxay saameynaysaa - gacaylka xun waxay noqon kartaa push haddii dealer u qalifyn waayo
• BLIND bet waxay noqon kartaa awood badan oo ku salaysan gacaylkaaga (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Ilaali tirada chip ee aad leedahay! Haddii ay gaadho 0 ama ka yar bilawga marhalka, aad waayaysid.

⚠️  MUHIMAADKA:
• ANTE iyo BLIND bets waa mandatory marhalkasta
• PLAY bets waa la doorto oo ahaan
• Hubi inaad gudbiso fariin sax ah, oo hal fariin oo keliya marhalkasta.
